summary: The candidate independently passes its supported Python/ASGI contract and corrects the prior weighted pre-body counterexample: with a four-item budget, only one of four concurrent unknown 4 MiB bodies reaches application receive, the other three are rejected with 503, and lease accounting returns to zero. This is a conservative partial fix, not full verification of the original Kimi-K2.6 production failure or unsupported Rust/EPD paths.

tests.what_was_measured: The prepared original base contains no pre-scheduler multimodal admission implementation or test symbols, confirming the reported class of requests is unbounded there. Raw evidence: evidence/base-source-check.log. The exact 200-client Kimi OOM was not reproduced due unavailable weights and host scale.

On exact candidate 7c363ab28fa2e7b4b390cd1105ca2c95119e221b, 12 focused middleware/controller tests passed, including full-budget reservation before body receive, lease resizing, rejection, and cleanup.

Independent budget=4 adversarial case: one of four concurrent 4 MiB bodies entered receive (4 MiB retained), three were rejected with HTTP 503 before receive, and inflight accounting returned to zero.

tests.command: pytest over all 12 changed test files
tests.what_was_measured: 447 passed and 58 subtests passed; two unrelated context-parallel tests failed because this ROCm/HIP source explicitly rejects prefill CP. Full output is retained and the failures do not exercise admission control.

gpu_execution.evidence: The reviewed change is CPU-side Python/ASGI admission accounting. No GPU numerical claim applies. Kimi-K2.6 weights and an equivalent 1.5 TiB host were unavailable; the qualified tiny Llama fixture is text-only and cannot validate Kimi multimodal behavior.

remaining_counterexamples: The exact 200-client, 28-images/request Kimi-K2.6 CPU-OOM workload on a 1.5 TiB host remains unverified because equivalent model weights and host scale were unavailable.
SGLANG_RUST_SERVER is explicitly rejected, so its separate frontend and multimodal preprocessing pipeline remain unsupported.
EPD language-only mode is explicitly rejected, so remote-encoder admission ownership remains unsupported.

Full-budget admission before parsing is intentionally conservative: while any admitted request retains item weight, another unknown body cannot enter receive, even if its eventual media count would fit. This bounds memory but sacrifices weighted concurrent body admission.
Socket, kernel, and protocol-server buffering before ASGI application receive are outside this limiter.
remaining_limitations: No exact Kimi-K2.6 end-to-end reproduction or equivalent-memory host was available.
Rust frontend and EPD language-only architectures remain unsupported by explicit validation.
No native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
The environment is AMD ROCm 7.2 with Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2; two unrelated prefill context-parallel tests are incompatible with HIP.
